differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame exhibit a pronounced dark falloff, creating a strong vignette.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame are bright and evenly lit, with no visible vignette.
differences.fix: Add a post-processing vignette or adjust the camera lens settings to simulate natural corner light falloff.

differences.a_observable: The white plastic keys have a cool, blueish color cast, particularly visible in the shadows.
differences.b_observable: The white plastic keys are neutral grey/white with no blue color cast.
differences.fix: Adjust the white balance or apply a cool color grade to the midtones and shadows to match the reference's blue tint.

differences.a_observable: The upper-right key ('Renewal Success') is heavily blurred due to a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The upper-right key is sharp and in focus.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and set a wider aperture to blur the background and foreground elements.

json.highest_impact_fix: Enable depth of field on the camera with a wider aperture to match the realistic focus falloff seen in the reference video.
